value.rationale: Anticanonical volume is a central numerical invariant of Fano varieties and is preserved in several birational-combinatorial constructions. Showing that it recovers the full pair of non-unit weights on a natural infinite canonical family from dimension four onward is a structural rigidity result, while the exact threefold exceptions identify the complete boundary of that rigidity.
